title: Quantum Sensing of Gravitational Frame Dragging with a Superfluid $^{4}\mathrm{He}$ Gyrometer
summary: A proposed lab-based quantum sensor could precisely measure within seconds the warping of spacetime caused by Earth’s rotation.

title: Giant Domain Walls and Intrinsic Heterogeneity in 214 Cuprate Superconductors
summary: Structural phase transitions generate complex microstructures that often govern material functionality, yet directly resolving their three-dimensional organization in bulk samples remains challenging. Here we employ scanning three-dimensional x-ray diffraction (3DXRD) to resolve the bulk microstruct…

title: Crossover to Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Criticality in an Infinite-Range Quantum Heisenberg Spin Glass
summary: A central question in frustrated quantum magnets is how quantum fluctuations destabilize spin-glass order and promote quantum spin-liquid behavior. title: Genuine and Spurious (Non-)Ergodicity in Single Particle Tracking
summary: The mean-squared increment is introduced as a new statistic to characterize single-particle positional time series data, providing a more precise and unambiguous method than previous approaches to evaluating ergodicity and helping to discriminate between different classes of stochastic processes.

title: Superconductivity in Monolayer-Trilayer Phase of ${\mathrm{La}}_{3}{\mathrm{Ni}}_{2}{\mathrm{O}}_{7}$ under High Pressure
summary: High-pressure studies on the 1313 monolayer-trilayer polymorph of reveal a dramatically reduced of , proving that coupled bilayer motifs are essential for superconductivity.

title: General Quantum Circuit Framework for Extended Wigner’s Friend Scenarios: Logically and Causally Consistent Reasoning without Absolute Measurement Events
summary: Researchers develop a quantum circuit framework for extended Wigner’s friend scenarios, resolving logical paradoxes by tracking Heisenberg cuts.

title: Flux-Floquet Instability in Fluctuating Superconductors
summary: Intense terahertz light triggers a flux-Floquet instability in high-temperature superconductors, generating a giant magnetic response that reveals bound electron pairs survive well above the superconducting transition temperature.

title: Low-Depth Quantum Symmetrization
summary: Researchers develop low-depth quantum symmetrization algorithms that enable efficient bosonic simulations, low-depth Dicke state preparation, and multiphoton interferometric imaging.

title: Particle View of Many-Body Electronic Structure with Neural Network Wave Function
summary: A combination of theoretical approaches bridges the gap between complex quantum wave functions and the classical picture of electron positions for molecules and solids.

title: Real-Space Visualization of the Intrinsic Aging in $n$-type ${\mathrm{Mg}}_{3}(\mathrm{Sb},\mathrm{Bi}{)}_{2}$ Thermoelectrics
summary: Spontaneous degradation of an Mg (Sb,Bi) thermoelectric demonstrates intrinsic defect relaxations rather than external stimuli can govern long-timescale property evolution.

title: Infinite Temperature at Zero Energy
summary: Researchers construct local Hamiltonians whose eigenstates inherit infinite-temperature properties, producing ground states with extensive entanglement.

title: Observation of Correlated Plasmons in Low-Valence Nickelates
summary: Resonant inelastic x-ray scattering measurements reveal propagating plasmons in the low-valence nickelate Pr Ni O with dynamics distinct from those of cuprate superconductors.

title: Unlocking Emergent Resilience in Amorphous Metamaterials via a Physics-Constrained Energy-Based Framework
summary: A physics-constrained design framework may aid the search for lightweight but resilient material.

title: Path-Dependency and Emergent Computing under Vectorial Driving
summary: A general framework unravels path dependencies across a wide range of driven complex materials.

title: Long-Lived Mechanically Detected Molecular Spins for Quantum Sensing
summary: Researchers integrate molecular spins with mechanical readout to detect nanotesla magnetic fields and resolve local nuclear spectra.

title: Covariant Path Integrals for Quantum Fields Backreacting on Classical Space-Time
summary: Researchers have developed a mathematical framework to bridge the gap between Einstein’s classical gravity and quantum mechanics. Their theory allows matter to remain quantum while space-time stays classical, offering a way to test if space and time truly require a quantum explanation.

title: Electronic Structure of Compressively Strained Bilayer Nickelate Thin Film
summary: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy of bilayer nickelate thin films reveals that the out-of-plane nickel orbital band shifts with strain and doping but is not required at the Fermi level for superconductivity.

title: Observation of Synchronization between Two Quantum van der Pol Oscillators in Trapped Ions
summary: Synchronization between two quantum van der Pol oscillators is achieved by engineering dissipation in a trapped-ion quantum simulator, where the synchronized state is encoded in a fixed relative phase accessible only through joint measurement.

title: Are Neural Networks Collision Resistant?
summary: A study of the computational complexity of finding collisions in a simple one-layer neural network shows that efficient algorithms fail to find collisions, a result of direct relevance for the definition of new cryptographic protocols based on machine-learning models.

title: Reassessing the Boundary between Classical and Nonclassical for Individual Quantum Processes
summary: Researchers have proposed a unified rule to distinguish quantum from classical processes, recovering many standard signatures of quantumness while revealing that many phenomena long thought to be classical actually possess hidden, intrinsically quantum properties that could power future technologies.

title: Super-resonance: Breaking the Bandwidth Limit of Resonant Modes and Its Application to Flow Control
summary: Super-resonance maintains a broadband out-of-phase response well beyond the characteristic bandwidth of conventional resonance, enabling broadband flow stabilization among other applications.
